svg.title: Patchy contest — 016 / The unreachable field — Reader
svg.desc: Fog of war, Patchy contest: 016 / The unreachable field, Reader. Schematic drawn claim terrain; P1 hatched; P2 dark; P3 dark; P4 dark; P5 hatched. P1 outer foothold hatched. Observation islands: response dark, correction hatched, configuration hatched, weights dark. P6 remains dark and unreachable. Dark means no available support, not false. Contours remain fixed across fixtures. Design sample, not adopted. Fog has a soft irregular edge; unexplored ground is opaque, ground that lost support stays dimly visible.
svg.text: OUR INFERENCE / SCHEMATIC TERRAIN / FOG IS COMPUTED, NOT MEASURED
A SINGLE-SOURCED CONFIGURATION ACCOUNT IS NOT ACCESS TO THE CAUSE.
016.2–5 / OAI-BH, one conference talk; no independent review
